about: I'm a security professional with a multidisciplinary background spanning penetration testing, software QA, test automation, and DevOps. My career started in quality engineering, where I spent three years building automated test frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and testing strategies for complex maritime software systems. That foundation in systematic testing and software engineering now powers my security work.

As a penetration tester and certified AI/ML security specialist (C-AI/MLPen), I bring a developer's perspective to security assessments. I perform secure code reviews, build custom testing tools in Python, and evaluate systems across web applications, APIs, mobile platforms, cloud infrastructure, and emerging AI/ML technologies.

I hold 20 professional certifications across application security, cloud security, mobile security, red teaming, and AI/ML security. Currently focused on the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, helping organizations understand and mitigate risks in AI-powered systems.

experience.title: Penetration Tester
responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive security assessments across web applications, APIs, mobile platforms (iOS/Android), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise systems, identifying critical vulnerabilities and attack vectors.
Design and develop custom security testing tools and automation scripts in Python to streamline assessment workflows and improve coverage.
Perform secure code reviews to identify and remediate security flaws, applying OWASP Top 10 principles and secure coding best practices.
Author detailed technical reports documenting vulnerability findings, risk ratings, and step-by-step remediation guidance.
Assist clients in implementing remediation recommendations and provide validation retesting services.

experience.title: Penetration Tester
responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive security assessments across web applications, APIs, mobile platforms (iOS/Android), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise systems, identifying critical vulnerabilities and attack vectors.
Perform external reconnaissance, OSINT, internal enumeration, exploitation, lateral movement, and privilege escalation to simulate real-world attack scenarios.
Design and develop custom red teaming tools and automation scripts in Python and Bash to enhance testing capabilities and efficiency.
Perform secure code reviews across client codebases, identifying security vulnerabilities and recommending secure coding practices.
Execute social engineering and phishing simulations to assess and improve organizational security awareness.
Author detailed technical reports documenting vulnerability findings, risk assessments, and prioritized remediation guidance.
Collaborate with clients on remediation implementation and provide validation retesting to confirm effective fixes.

experience.title: DevOps & Test Automation Engineer
responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Atlassian Bamboo, Visual Studio AppCenter, and Bitbucket for onboard ship software delivery.

Lead security automation initiatives as part of the onboard software security taskforce, developing security tools and installers in C#, PowerShell, and JavaScript (Wix#, NSIS), and implementing automated SAST scanning with SonarQube and Python (MobSF).
Build and maintain comprehensive automated test suites including API tests (Postman/Newman, JMeter), unit tests, and integration tests using JUnit, Gradle, and Groovy.
Mentor junior test engineers in test strategy planning and test management using Zephyr and mind-mapping techniques for complex onboard marine software systems.

experience.title: Software QA Test Engineer
responsibilities: Drive end-to-end quality assurance across the full software development lifecycle, ensuring products meet functional requirements, quality standards, and release criteria.

Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for complex onboard ship software including server applications, client software, and iOS/Android mobile applications using Zephyr and mind-mapping techniques.
Triage, investigate, and manage backlog items including stories, improvements, and bug reports across multiple product teams.
Configure, monitor, and maintain onboard simulation environments for end-to-end integration testing of marine software systems.
Administer and maintain CI/CD infrastructure (Jenkins, Visual Studio AppCenter) supporting automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Robot Framework, Xamarin UI Test, Postman/Newman, JMeter, Gradle, Groovy, and AutoIt.
Maintain unit and integration tests using JUnit, Gradle, and Groovy, ensuring continuous test coverage.
Perform integration testing with third-party hardware systems including Voyage Data Recorders (VDR) from Danelec Marine and other maritime equipment vendors.
